proposal.expected_benefit: Preserves the correct defensive decision while ensuring the system remains vigilant against real-world threats by not overgeneralizing from simulation-only scenarios.
proposal.problem: The defense correctly identified a healthy four-validator consensus with no adversarial payload, but the simulation-only nature of the scenario may lead to overconfidence in the system's security.
proposal.proposed_change: Maintain the current successful behavior of allowing healthy consensus scenarios, but add a flag to differentiate between simulation and real-world environments. This flag will ensure that the system remains cautious and does not assume real-world security based solely on simulation results.
proposal.title: Preservation of Successful Behavior in Simulation Context
verification_tests: Test the system's response to a simulation-only healthy consensus scenario to ensure it still allows execution.
Test the system's response to a real-world healthy consensus scenario to ensure it also allows execution.
Verify that the system does not assume real-world security based solely on simulation results.
